turns.text: Just so it's on the table, implementation is a one-time eighteen thousand.
That's fine. We've approved ninety-six total for year one, implementation included.
Renewal after that would be around eighty a year, but that's next year's problem.
Got it. Our champion mentioned your CEO is excited about this?
Our CEO is a big fan, but she doesn't touch software purchases. Bilal Haddad, our Director of IT, signs those.
Thanks. What's next on your side?
I'll have legal's redlines to you by Thursday, and then I'll send over some times to walk through them.
